stock_segments.discussion_summary: Fractal reported Q2 with strong revenue growth but disappointing EBIT margin collapse to 6% from expected double digits. Sales out grew 39% year-on-year to 180M SEK, but net sales of 215M SEK showed inventory buildup in US channels ahead of tariffs. Gross margin crushed by US tariffs (-3.5% points), FX effects (-3% points), and higher freight (-1.8% points), dropping from 41.4% to 35.6%. New products Scape (headphones) and Refine (chair) received good reviews but not yet contributing materially to results. Gaming chair sales actually declined sequentially in accessories segment. Management expects net sales to align more closely with sales out going forward. EV/EBIT 18.4x on base case 8% margin, 12.3x on bull case 12% margin. Host watching for margin recovery before considering position.

summary: Episode focused on HelloFresh's Q2 report and turnaround story, Evolution's renewed Black Cube report concerns, and Fractal Gaming's disappointing margin pressure. HelloFresh dropped 15% on revenue decline but hosts see deep value with EV/FCF around 9-10, expecting margin recovery from 2% to 4% by 2026 through 300M EUR cost savings program. Evolution facing renewed regulatory concerns but maintaining positions. Fractal's gross margin crushed by tariffs and FX, hosts watching from sidelines. Brief market overview showing many bombed-out stocks including Embracer, gaming names, but some turnarounds emerging like Pexip and AUG. Upcoming reports of interest: Chefello, Generic, Premium Snacks, Infracom, Sleep Cycle.
